UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile storing researcher or participant identity and anonymous study cohort parameters.

id.description: The unique user authentication ID matching auth.uid.

email.description: User's email address if authenticated via Google.

displayName.description: User's public or research display name.

aliasLabel.description: Optional research cohort label or study group.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp of user profile creation.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last profile update.

ScreeningSession.title: ScreeningSession
ScreeningSession.description: Complete multimodal assessment record storing handwriting, voice, movement, questionnaire, fusion scores, and explainability attributions.

anonymousCohortId.description: Anonymous research ID at time of screening.

dayOffset.description: Day offset from baseline longitudinal study.

credibleInterval95.description: Lower and upper bounds of 95% credible interval.

handwritingResults.description: Extracted handwriting and Archimedean spiral kinematic biomarkers.

voiceResults.description: Extracted voice dysphonia and acoustic perturbation metrics.

movementResults.description: Extracted motor tapping rhythmicity and fatigue metrics.

questionnaireResults.description: Behavioral inventory responses and non-motor score.

multimodalScores.description: Modality-specific probabilities and late-fusion weight allocation.

explainabilityData.description: SHAP-calibrated feature attributions and counterfactual recommendations.

clinicalSummary.description: Non-diagnostic clinical research summary and follow-up guidance.

LongitudinalHistory.title: LongitudinalHistory
LongitudinalHistory.description: Summarized temporal trajectory point for fast longitudinal time-series visualization.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document restricted strictly to the authenticated account owner.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Multimodal screening sessions and complete biomarker data owned by the user.

/users/{userId}/longitudinal_history/{hi.description: Temporal assessment points for longitudinal tracking owned by the user.
